authorization: The owner said "Okay, let's get these seven follow-ups in place and then get this all shipped systematically end to end" about #540 and its follow-ups (#552).

release.summary: A chapter paints four verses at a time, eight for the owner (an admin session, who also gets 40 image requests a minute against everyone else's 20). Short refusals are waited out: the site's rate limit, an OpenRouter 429 and an in-flight-budget 402. The job pauses only when waiting won't help. Follow-ups (#552): claim numbers fence verse writes; a failed Convex write restarts the run after 5 s, up to three times, then blocks with save_failed; one pause table gives the same status and message live, after a reload and in a second tab; HTTP-date Retry-After.
release.leftOut: Follow-ups listed in the PR body: one retry loop over the latest response, an explicit request state for a refused withdrawal, and a new request id after a refusal at the final charge.

steps.convex: Pushed to unique-impala-244 from 700b289f (schema: optional bulkGenerationVerses.claim; bulkGenerations; rateLimit; verseImages.withdrawRefusedRequest). The dry run validated the schema and deleted no indexes.

smoke.after: visibible.com redirects to /genesis/1/1 (200), and api.visibible.com answers. For a fresh guest, /api/rate-limit-status reports generate-image 20 of 20. An automatic zero-credit request for Job 1:6 got 402 (required 6, available 0, nothing charged), and the allowance then read 19 of 20, so the sid-aware Convex rate limit is live. No chapter was painted: a real bulk run needs credits and the owner's budget.
smoke.beforeRelease: npm test 1630/1630 merged with main, tsc clean, eslint 0 errors, CI quality-gates green on 8d7fe3de. Ten Sol review rounds (GPT-6.2 Sol, xhigh), five for #530 and five for #552; every repro is kept as a test. The last Sol finding (S14) was fixed with the guard Sol proposed and had tested in a scratch copy. CodeRabbit's two reviews are answered; the paid on-demand review was not run.

rollback.convex: Push the Convex functions from 69594448. The optional claim field can stay: older code ignores it.

productionWrites: One guest session and one refused (402) request record from the smoke check.
